articles.title: Partnerships & Stakeholders: Science and Technology Community
articles.description: The role of global science, academia, research and innovation is enshrined in the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction where it is recognized for the catalytic, boundary-pushing and transformative potential it holds for addressing the dynamic drivers of disaster risk.

articles.title: Waves of Change: Urban resilience pathways to flood and water scarcity risk
articles.description: This report showcases how cities across Europe and Central Asia are tackling floods and water scarcity through integrated urban resilience. It highlights practical case studies, lessons learned, and recommendations to strengthen water resilience.

articles.title: Community Disaster Resilience Network Association (CDRNA)
articles.description: The Community Disaster Resilience Network (CDRN) Association is a Hungarian civil society organization dedicated to empowering communities through innovative disaster preparedness, education, and technology-driven resilience solutions.

articles.title: Jordan strengthens local resilience through climate action and wildfire prevention
articles.description: In Jordan, a local resilience planning process supported by the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR) has evolved into a growing movement of community-led action, government ownership and climate resilience.

articles.title: Resilient Western Balkans: Strengthening transboundary collaboration and capacities on disaster risk reduction and Early Warning Systems in the Western Balkans
articles.description: The Year 1 narrative report highlights progress in strengthening disaster risk reduction, early warning systems and transboundary cooperation across the Western Balkans.

articles.title: UNDRR and CCRO Network advance business resilience agenda in Harvard Business Review (HBR)
articles.description: The UN Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR), in collaboration with the Chief Resilience Officer (CCRO) network, has published a thought leadership article in Harvard Business Review.

articles.title: Take part in the EW4All global consultation survey
articles.description: The Early Warnings for All (EW4All) Pillar Leads, UNDRR, WMO, ITU and IFRC, invite your feedback on the impact of the initiative to date, the gaps that remain in early warning systems, and the way forward for global cooperation to support them

articles.title: United Nations Senior Leaders call for stronger joint action to reduce disaster risk and protect development gains
articles.description: Thirty-six UN entities convened to reinforce disaster risk reduction as central to sustainable development, adopting new targets and priority actions to guide coordinated country-level support through 2030.
